one_line: Name the viewer in the first word, show the product at 2 s, then one labelled demo per feature.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close selfie, a smiling woman looks at the lens, no speech. Black-box text over her chest: "גננת? אל תגיעי לגן בלי לראות את זה" plus a pointing emoji. 0:02 cut to a teal hanging organiser of cards, new text.
q1_hook.why: "גננת?" names one audience in the first word, so the right viewer stops (H1, T3), and the line opens a gap the tour answers (H5). A face with no voice is half of H4, and a text-only hook has no sound side (H6). The text sits low (T4).

beats.what: Silent smiling selfie with the black-box text
beats.why: A person to trust, and a line only gan teachers will answer

beats.what: Teal hanging organiser with cards; text "בואי תראי איך לומדים אותיות ומעשירים את השפה בצ'יק צ'אק!!!"
beats.why: Product and promise arrive together at 2 s

beats.what: Label "זיהוי אותיות"; letter cards, then a heart clothespin clipped onto one card
Label "סידור אותיות ברצף"; blurred pan over domino tiles, then tiles in rows
Label "אות פותחת"; magnetic letters tipped from a bag, one placed on a picture card
beats.why: The pouring and placing give motion inside the explanation

beats.what: Label "מודעות פונולוגית"; a hand fills the missing letter in word strips
beats.why: A visible task with a before and after

beats.what: Label "צליל פותח" to 0:23, then blurred picture cards with no label
beats.why: The last two seconds lose the label and sharpness

beats.what: Label "חריזה", then "מעשירים את השפה בערכה אחת!!!" over rhyme cards
beats.why: Summary line; no ask on screen

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. Caption, last line: a question with a comment word, "מי מעוניינת לקבל את כל הפרטים? כתבי לי "אני" בתגובות".
q2_flow.why: A new labelled game every 3 to 5 s keeps the middle moving, each fact with a visible action (R3, E2). At 29 s, one demo per label, the length fits the content (R2), and it stops on the last label (R1, E8). Nothing gives a reason to send or save it (R5).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: the last frame, 0:27-0:28, is "מעשירים את השפה בערכה אחת!!!". Caption, last line: "מי מעוניינת לקבל את כל הפרטים? כתבי לי "אני" בתגובות".
q3_cta.why: One clear ask with a purpose, getting the details (C1, C2). But it is only in the caption, below "more", and never said or shown after the demos (against C6). "אני" is generic and no price is given, so the viewer cannot tell what the reply brings (C3).

q4_shown.what: Her face 0:00-0:01; the kit's hanging organiser 0:02-0:03; then top-down hands only: letter cards with clothespins, domino tiles, magnetic letters on picture cards, missing-letter strips, picture cards, rhyme cards. No child, brand, price or result.
q4_shown.why: Each part of the kit is handled and tied to a named skill, so the viewer sees what is inside (S4, R3). The kit is on screen throughout with a stated benefit and no brand time (C7). Nobody vouches and no child uses it, so the claim is untested (S6).

q5_edit.what: About 9 shots in 29 s (about 3 s each): a static selfie, a cut at about 1.7 s, then top-down shots every 3 to 5 s, with whip pans and blur at 0:08-0:09 and 0:24-0:25. One centred label per game. No speech.
q5_edit.why: A cut at 1.7 s and a new label every 3 to 5 s keep a moderate pace (E1, E2). Labels carry everything, so it works muted (T1), but sound-on viewers get nothing extra (E4). Blur at 0:08-0:09 and 0:24-0:25 smears the cards. It ends on the last label (E8).

q6_topic.what: A ready-to-use letters and language kit for a kindergarten group; it serves gan teachers who need quick small-group activities.
q6_topic.why: The buyer is named and the task recurs, so the right viewer sees herself (K7). No emotional peak and no story, only a tidy tour (K1, K2). The audience is teachers, not parents, so only the structure carries over to LumeBook.

q7_filmed.what: Close selfie at eye level against a white wall in daylight; handheld shots of the hanging organiser; then handheld top-down shots over a brown table in dim indoor light, a window and garden visible at 0:06-0:07. Hands only, no child.
q7_filmed.why: A close face frame reads well on a phone and looks homemade (H8). Top-down hands show the cards the way the viewer would hold them (F5), and the cards fill the frame in most shots (F4). Dim light, handheld shake and blur make some cards hard to read (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:01 black-box text, about 66 to 83 percent down: "גננת? אל תגיעי לגן בלי לראות את זה". 0:02-0:03 white outlined text, mid-frame: "בואי תראי איך לומדים אותיות ומעשירים את השפה בצ'יק צ'אק!!!". Centred white labels 0:04-0:26: "זיהוי אותיות", "סידור אותיות ברצף", "אות פותחת", "מודעות פונולוגית", "צליל פותח", "חריזה". 0:27-0:28: "מעשירים את השפה בערכה אחת!!!". No subtitles.
q8_text.caption: "גננת," then "אל תגיעי לגן בלי לראות את זה!". About 73 words: the hook, a benefit line, the kit name, five bullet items, a question with the comment word "אני", 3 hashtags (#גננות #גןילדים #גננתלגילהרך). No disclosure.
q8_text.why: Short labels held 3 to 5 s make it readable on mute (T1, T2, T5). The first card is up only about 2 s and sits low in the frame (T5, T4). The caption repeats the hook in its first line and lists the contents in parents' and teachers' search words (T7).

weak_points: Dim light and handheld blur; the ask only in the caption; no price, brand or child; the face goes silent after 2 s; blurred, unlabelled cards at 0:24-0:25; hook text low in the frame.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the book top-down in daylight with a steady phone, one centred label per part (cover, name in the text, pages), and put the ask on the last frame.
not_verified: Speech or music: the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech; music cannot be told. Her profession, the brand and the price. Corrections: the label "צליל פותח" ends at 0:23 and 0:24-0:25 carry no label; the second hook text, white without a box, runs 0:02-0:03, not to 4 s.
